item.title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
item.description: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.

item.title: Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows
item.description: The years-long wait for access to the grid and new turbines is causing data center builders to turn to an unusual, less-efficient and less environmentally friendly solution: once-discarded jet engines.

item.title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
item.description: Cybersecurity-focused Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $360 million for a new flagship fund and another $130 million for a separate investment vehicle.

item.title: Hiding inside Palantir’s skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal
item.description: Palantir's U.S. commercial revenue surpassed U.S. government revenue for the first time ever.

item.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
item.description: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer.

item.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
item.description: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

item.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
item.description: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.

item.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
item.description: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.

item.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
item.description: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.

item.title: The TechCrunch Founder Summit agenda is only half the reason to be in Boston on November 4
item.description: On November 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 brings founders and VCs to Boston's SoWa Power Station for practical insights and connections. Register before prices increase at the door.

item.title: Tomorrow: TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston and when pass rates increase
item.description: Secure your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass savings before prices increase tomorrow at 9 a.m. ET. Save up to $100 on your pass, and get a second for free.
